driver: tokenomics.eval.signal_check (headroom audit) + tokenomics.eval.orderer_oracle (directed routing search oracle / label generator) + tokenomics.train.orderer_improve (M2 expert iteration: DAgger orderer clone on search-improved labels, producer fixed v4)
question: EXP-0001..0004 proved a trained producer can IMITATE and GENERALIZE the hardcoded expert (stock_aware), but a clone is bounded by its teacher and cannot prove IMPROVEMENT. Can a learned agent GREATLY BEAT the hardcoded baseline (stock_aware producer + proportional orderer)? Gate: does the benchmark even HAVE reachable headroom — can any oracle/search/heuristic beat the baseline on these environments? If not, the benchmark cannot prove learning superiority and the target must shift to efficiency (fewer rejects/waste/restoration, better survival under shocks).

stages.Headroom audit (Stage 0, DONE, local): signal_check baseline matrix on the depth-3 scale topologies (seeds 0,3,4,5). RESULT: reachable headroom EXISTS and demand is NOT saturated. (a) stock_aware+proportional rejects 78-180 consumer orders (cons-fail) on s0/s3/s5 while capmin stays 38-68 -> not a death/capacity wall, orders left on the table (s4 near-saturated, cons-fail 21.8). (b) Existence proof: random+random BEATS stock_aware+proportional on s3 (cons-ok 184.6 vs 117.2; cu-ok 332 vs 201) -> a non-baseline policy does strictly better, so a learnable policy can too. (c) Lever localised: holding stock_aware producer, proportional is the best DETERMINISTIC orderer everywhere (beats even_split), but the s3 random win + EXP-0004 orderer-coupling point at the ORDERER as the weak link; the stock_aware producer is strong. Gate PASSED: benchmark is suitable.
stages.M0 definition (refinement): stock_aware+proportional is the best baseline on s0/s4/s5 but is BEATEN by random on s3. For a credible 'learning is superior' claim, M0 should be the BEST-OF-BASELINE ENVELOPE per topology (upper envelope of the baseline grid), not a single fixed combo random can beat. Keep stock_aware+proportional as the named reference; bar = envelope.
stages.Orderer ceiling probe (Stage 1, DONE, lo: Domain is deterministic + deepcopy-able (~3ms) -> search/MPC feasible. (1a) Producer-vs-orderer ISOLATION (decisive): holding stock_aware producer fixed, a RANDOM orderer beats proportional by 14-76% on 6/8 seeds (s0 1.24, s3 1.76, s5 1.22, s6 1.14, s8 1.32, s9 1.24; s4 saturated 1.00, s7 tie 0.99), CIs non-overlapping (s3 200.8+/-6 vs 352.8+/-14). Random PRODUCER collapses everything -> headroom is ENTIRELY ORDERER-SIDE and general; stock_aware producer near-optimal. proportional concentrates routing -> bottlenecks/TTL-2 fails; random spreads load. Success bar (>=10-20%) already shown achievable by random. (1b) Per-cycle MPC over {even_split,proportional,obs_price} scored 0.95 on s3 (does NOT beat baseline) - the winner (random ~1.76x) is OUTSIDE the deterministic candidate set, and short greedy lookahead is myopic under TTL-2. => label oracle must SEARCH routing splits stochastically + longer rollout, not switch fixed orderers. Tool: eval.orderer_oracle.
stages.Mechanism probe (Stage 1c, DONE, local): fixed_random (ONE random split reused every cycle, open-loop) is BAD on all 8 seeds (<= proportional, often <= even_split), while re-sampled random wins. => the headroom source is PER-CYCLE re-routing (temporal diversification escaping bottleneck ruts), NOT a better fixed split shape. Capturable only by a STATE-REACTIVE orderer; learnability test = does a DIRECTED per-cycle search beat proportional. logs/orderer_mechanism_probe.txt.
stages.Directed routing-search oracle (Stage 1d: orderer_oracle --samples K: each cycle score the baselines + K freshly-sampled fixed routing vectors by lookahead rollout, commit argmax (reproducible, sample RNG seeded by (seed,cycle)). lookahead=12 K=12: beats proportional +32-52% on s0/3/5/8 (499/377, 317/208, 619/438, 615/448), 0 death, sample_wins/ep 58-94 (a SEARCHED routing wins most cycles). DETERMINISTIC -> clean DAgger label source (unlike random). Doesn't fully reach random's 1.76x (mildly myopic; more K/longer rollout closes it) but clears the bar. M2 DE-RISKED. logs/search_oracle_l12_s12.csv.
stages.Expert iteration on the orderer (Stage 2: train.orderer_improve, producer fixed at EXP-0004 v4, oracle lookahead 12 K 12, DAgger x2 (round0 on-oracle BC + round1 relabel), masked-MSE, train seeds 0-5 x 3 episode seeds (27k->54k labels). HELD-OUT eval seeds 6,7,8,9 (5 episode seeds), M2 vs M0 (stock_aware+proportional) and best-of-baseline envelope (sa x {prop,even,random} + random+random); canonical local re-eval of m2_v1.pt (pod CSV differed <=2% via float drift, same verdict): s6 478.6+/-15 / M0 424.8 / env 483.4(sa+random) -> M2/M0 1.13 M2/env 0.99; s7 465.4+/-19 / 438.6 / 438.6(sa+prop) -> 1.06 / 1.06; s8 542.8+/-19 / 403.4 / 531.4(sa+random) -> 1.35 / 1.02; s9 456.0+/-15 / 405.4 / 504.0(sa+random) -> 1.13 / 0.91. 0 death all seeds. VERDICT M2-v1 = PARTIAL PASS: (1) improvement over the NAMED baseline M0 PROVEN -- beats it on all 4 held-out by +6..+35% (mean +15%), CIs clear M0 (M0 deterministic/seed-invariant); M1=v4+prop==M0 by construction so this is genuine learning not imitation. (2) Deterministic clone FAITHFULLY captured the teacher (s8 oracle +37% vs M2 +35%) -> imitability/state-decodability OPEN RISK RESOLVED, no stochastic orderer needed. (3) Does NOT clear the strict random-inclusive ENVELOPE (ties/edges random s6 0.99/s8 1.02, beats M0-envelope s7, LOSES s9 0.91) -- teacher-strength ceiling NOT imitation failure (the lookahead-12 search itself never beat random, Stage 1d). CORRECTED by Stage 2b: the residual is a CLONE/GENERALIZATION gap, NOT a teacher ceiling. NEXT = M2-v2 better clone (more train topologies + multi-seed), reuse current L12/K12 teacher; no stronger oracle, no stochastic, no PPO. Artifacts m2_v1.pt, m2_v1_heldout.csv.
stages.Teacher-strength audit (Stage 2b, DONE,: orderer_oracle --prod-ckpt v4 --envelope on held-out seeds 6,7,8,9 (5 episode seeds, L12 K12): does the SEARCH TEACHER (what M2 imitates) beat the envelope on held-out, esp s9? RESULT: oracle >= envelope on 4/4, 0 death -- s6 499/483(sa+random) o/env 1.03; s7 491/439(sa+prop) 1.12; s8 591/531(sa+random) 1.11; s9 545/504(sa+random) 1.08. The current L12/K12 teacher ALREADY clears the strict bar on every held-out topology INCLUDING s9 (+8% over random). vs M0(v4+prop): 1.09/1.12/1.32/1.44. => EXP-0005 residual is a CLONE/GENERALIZATION gap not a teacher-strength gap: the clone retains 92-96% of the teacher on s6-8 but only 84% on s9, exactly where M2 ties/loses the envelope. FLIPS the M2-v1 'teacher-myopia' reading (that extrapolated Stage 1d's vs-proportional numbers on different seeds). Per the pre-registered decision rule (oracle beats envelope but clone fails -> clone/generalization issue), next lever = the CLONE not the oracle; the lookahead/K grid is DEPRIORITIZED. Tool: eval.orderer_oracle --prod-ckpt/--envelope. Artifact artifacts/oracle_audit_L12_K12.csv.
stages.Coverage probe (Stage 2c M2-v2a, DONE, R: Stage 2b pointed at the clone; the pre-registered first lever was MORE TRAINING TOPOLOGIES (the coverage fix that worked for the EXP-0004 producer). M2-v2a = identical recipe to M2-v1 (v4 producer, L12 K12 teacher, DAgger x2, masked-MSE) but train topologies DOUBLED 6->12 (seeds 0-5 + 10-15), label-seeds 3, held-out 6,7,8,9 x 20 episode seeds. RESULT: coverage REFUTED. Canonical local re-eval of m2_v2a.pt: s6 456/M0 413/env 476(sa+random) -> M2/M0 1.10 M2/env 0.96; s7 459/437/437(sa+prop) -> 1.05/1.05; s8 537/399/537(sa+random) -> 1.35/1.00; s9 435/402/500(sa+random) -> 1.08/0.87. Doubling topologies REGRESSED the held-out envelope ratio on ALL 4 seeds vs M2-v1 (s6 0.99->0.96, s8 1.02->1.00, s9 0.91->0.87) and M2/M0 on 3; round-1 fit MSE ROSE (3.14->3.84). MECHANISM = single shared GaussianActor regresses-to-mean across more heterogeneous topologies (orderer winning-routing is topology-specific, does not pool like the more-invariant producer rule). => the s9 gap is clone CAPACITY/EXPRESSIVITY, not data; with teacher sufficient (2b) and more-data hurting (2c) and stronger-oracle deprioritized, remaining levers are higher-capacity/topology-conditioned net or STOCHASTIC routing distillation -- both deferred. M2-v1 stays the best clone / the EXP-0005 deliverable (M2-v2a dominates it nowhere). Improvement vs the NAMED baseline still proven (M2-v2a beats M0 on all 4); envelope-tie is the honest standing limit. Run-to-run ~3% drift (eval-only doesn't pin BLAS threads) is within CI bands. OPEN FORK before next pod: (A) accept M2-v1 / (B) higher-capacity or topology-conditioned net / (C) stochastic routing distillation. No PPO, no stronger oracle, no more data. Artifacts m2_v2a.pt, m2_v2a_heldout.csv.

models.M0: stock_aware producer + proportional orderer (named hardcoded baseline). Bar = best-of-baseline envelope per topology.
models.M1: EXP-0004 v4 producer + proportional orderer (best clone; matches stock_aware, does NOT beat it -- imitation ceiling).
models.M2: LEARNED orderer (search-improved labels) + v4 producer -- tests the identified orderer lever first.
models.M3: LEARNED producer + LEARNED orderer, both from search-improved labels -- the full improvement claim.

success_criterion: STRICT, with CIs across many seeds/topologies. Primary: M3 (or M2) beats M0 envelope by >=10-20% on a held-out suite on consumer units/orders fulfilled. Secondary (if units saturate, e.g. s4): SAME completed units with materially fewer replenishment rejections / less wasted inventory / less restoration cost / better survival under harder shocks. Report mean +/- CI, per-topology, train vs held-out split.

params.topologies: scale_d3 seeds 0,3,4,5 (audit); held-out suite seeds 6,7,8,9 (reuse EXP-0004 split)

artifacts.logs/headroom_signalcheck_s{0,3,4,5}.txt: Stage 0 headroom audit: full signal_check baseline matrix per seed (depth-3 native scale topology)
artifacts.logs/orderer_headroom_random_vs_proporti: Stage 1a producer-vs-orderer isolation: stock_aware producer x {proportional,even_split,obs_price,random} orderers, 8 seeds, cu_ok mean+/-stdev -> random orderer +14-76% over proportional on 6/8
artifacts.logs/orderer_mechanism_probe.txt: Stage 1c mechanism: fixed_random (open-loop) vs re-sampled random, 8 seeds -> win is per-cycle re-routing not a fixed shape
artifacts.logs/search_oracle_l12_s12.csv: Stage 1d directed routing search (lookahead 12, K=12): beats proportional +32-52% on s0/3/5/8, deterministic -> M2 label source
artifacts.tokenomics.eval.orderer_oracle: oracle module: per-cycle search over orderer routings via deepcopy rollout; --samples K = directed routing search (Stage 1d / Stage 2 label generator), 0 = switch among named baselines (Stage 1b). _search_best_pol = the reusable per-cycle search primitive (shared with the Stage 2 trainer)
artifacts.tokenomics.train.orderer_improve: Stage 2 M2 trainer: expert-iterate a learned orderer toward the search oracle (producer fixed v4); label-gen (masked per-agent targets) -> masked-MSE clone -> optional DAgger -> save M2 pair -> eval vs M0+envelope on held-out with CIs. Runpod (real run).
artifacts.artifacts/m2_v1.pt: Stage 2 M2-v1 checkpoint: EXP-0004 v4 producer + learned orderer (DAgger x2 on lookahead-12 K-12 search labels). load_policies-compatible.
artifacts.artifacts/m2_v1_heldout.csv: Stage 2 M2-v1 held-out eval (seeds 6,7,8,9 x5, canonical local re-eval of m2_v1.pt): M2 vs M0 and best-of-baseline envelope, cu + 95% CI + rejects + invest.
artifacts.artifacts/oracle_audit_L12_K12.csv: Stage 2b teacher-strength audit: search oracle (v4 producer, L12 K12) vs M0 and envelope on held-out 6,7,8,9 -> oracle >= envelope 4/4 (the teacher already clears the bar; residual is the clone).
artifacts.artifacts/m2_v2a.pt: Stage 2c M2-v2a checkpoint: v4 producer + learned orderer, train topologies DOUBLED 6->12 (seeds 0-5+10-15). Coverage REFUTED -- regresses M2-v1 on held-out. load_policies-compatible.
artifacts.artifacts/m2_v2a_heldout.csv: Stage 2c M2-v2a held-out eval (seeds 6,7,8,9 x20, canonical local re-eval): regresses the envelope ratio on all 4 seeds vs M2-v1 -> coverage is not the lever.

compute.where: Stage 0 audit: local CPU. Oracle + expert-iteration training: Runpod (per CLAUDE.md HARD RULE).

reproduce: cd tokenomics && for S in 0 3 4 5; do ../.venv/bin/python -m tokenomics.eval.signal_check --config ../experiments/EXP-0005-learning-vs-baseline/configs/scale_d3_s$S.json --seeds 5 --horizon 100; done
